evidence: Read the full diff and the head versions of tools/review-bench/run-gentle.sh (top 20 lines) and tools/review-bench/shim/claude. Nothing was run: go test, shellcheck, jq, and the live R1-R8 run are not run. The claim that R1-R8 all approved comes from the prompt, not from my own check.

F1 is resolved on reading. span in score.sh now drops empty parts after split("-"), so "89-" becomes from=89 and to=89. The new fixture case R4 and its subtest pin that behavior: a finding at line 92 is located and one at line 93 is not.

F2 is resolved on reading. run-gentle.sh now runs rm -rf "$out" before each run, after the case id is validated, so no stale final.json, cap files, or summary.json survive a rerun. A run that ends without approved or correction_required now exits 4 with a message.

F3 is resolved on reading. The shim now runs mkdir -p on scratch and sets a trap that removes both temp files on EXIT. The real claude call is not exec'd, so the trap fires, and the output is printed before exit.

New acknowledgement and new-start paths: acknowledge_pending acts only on the approved_acknowledgement_required reason and runs the provider-returned command. The fallback START is built only after the plain STATUS returns target_already_acknowledged, and the tokens are quoted with printf %q. I found no defect in either path.
